svg.title: LoRA - Low-Rank Adaptation
svg.desc: For one selected 4096 x 4096 linear weight matrix with rank r = 8, W_eff = W0 + sBA, with s = alpha/r. W0 remains a full-sized frozen base, B has shape 4096 x 8 and A has shape 8 x 4096. Only A and B are trainable: 32768 + 32768 = 65536 parameters; the frozen base has 16777216. The equal-sized base and effective matrices are schematic textures, not measured weights, not one cell per parameter, and not parameter-area comparisons. Low rank constrains the update BA, not W0 or W_eff. Base and adapter are both required.
svg.text: All grids: schematic, not parameter area
